sources.producer: Osmium 1.19.1 tags-filter via api/scripts/osmium-runtime.sh; XMLReader streamed the complete filtered relation output
sources.method_limit: Tag-level full filtered-relation scan; it did not resolve member geometry for the 29 omitted relations.

sources.producer: OfflinePedestrianRestrictionPolicy source scan classification plus stored v3 relation audit
sources.method_limit: Source classification covers all 648 relation tags; member-form counts are available only for the 619 stored relations.

Long segments use graph_edges.length_meters > 250; boundary membership uses any latitude/longitude bound within 0.0005 degrees; crossing count counts graph nodes with a nonempty crossing tag. These are OSM graph diagnostics, not field safety evidence.

Coverage describes stored stop/place/transfer rows and the exact graph snapshot; it is not geographic, sidewalk, population, or field coverage. quality_summary was emitted before the detailed quality evidence was attached.
Static readiness evidence from pinned source/graph reports; no current PostgreSQL staging claim.
Derived summary only; it did not open the SQLite graph or PBF and repeats rather than independently resolves source discrepancies.

metric_claims.definition: Relations selected by the recorded type/restriction tag filter in the complete filtered PBF pass.
metric_claims.filters: r/type=restriction plus pedestrian-specific restriction key expressions listed in the source scan report.
metric_claims.interpretation: Source-level inventory, not the number of relation rows persisted in the v3 graph.

metric_claims.definition: Mode applicability classification across the 648 tag-scanned source relations.
metric_claims.filters: Same complete filtered source relation inventory; generic conditional and psv-only relation tags remain in this source-level classification.
metric_claims.interpretation: No source relation was classified pedestrian_applicable or ambiguous in this audit; this does not mean the router implements arbitrary pedestrian turn restrictions.

metric_claims.definition: Source relation tags explicitly classified as applying to pedestrian routing by the Batch031 mode policy.
metric_claims.interpretation: Source-specific to this snapshot; unsupported pedestrian restrictions remain a general router limitation.

metric_claims.definition: Source relation tags whose mode applicability could not be established by the Batch031 policy.
metric_claims.interpretation: Source-specific result; no general support for unknown restriction modes is implied.

metric_claims.definition: Source restrictions that apply or may apply to pedestrians but lack implemented routing semantics.
metric_claims.interpretation: The zero is an audit result for this source snapshot, not a general capability claim.

metric_claims.unit: restriction relation rows in SQLite v3
metric_claims.definition: Relations captured by the v3 graph's stored-relation predicate and included in its validated restriction inventory.
metric_claims.filters: Stored graph relation table; source scan records 29 additional conditional/psv-only relations omitted by that predicate.
metric_claims.interpretation: 619 stored plus 29 source-only relations equals 648 source relations; these values have different denominators and must not share one unlabeled metric.

metric_claims.unit: source relations not stored in SQLite v3
metric_claims.definition: Source relation IDs present in the complete tag scan but not captured by the v3 stored predicate.
metric_claims.filters: 28 generic restriction:conditional-only and one restriction:psv-only relation.
metric_claims.scope: Same source and graph snapshot identities recorded in this registry.
metric_claims.interpretation: The omitted relations are retained in the source audit sidecar; their member geometry is not represented by the v3 graph inventory.

metric_claims.definition: Legacy summary field produced by the coverage audit's metadata lookup with a zero fallback when the metadata key is absent.
metric_claims.filters: No SQLite edge scan is established by this field value.
metric_claims.scope: Batch032 coverage report at repository revision 90a40fc.
metric_claims.interpretation: Do not present as zero measured long edges.

metric_claims.definition: SQLite graph_edges rows with length_meters strictly greater than 250.
metric_claims.filters: >250 m; source way references and endpoint geometry reviewed; maximum recorded segment is 867 m.
metric_claims.scope: Exact graph SHA256 and graph content fingerprint in this registry.
metric_claims.interpretation: Source-backed geometry review is not field safety verification.

metric_claims.definition: Legacy summary field produced with a zero fallback when metadata quality-review values were unavailable.
metric_claims.filters: No SQLite boundary query is established by this field value.
metric_claims.scope: Batch032 coverage report at repository revision 90a40fc.
metric_claims.interpretation: Do not present as zero measured boundary nodes.

metric_claims.definition: Graph nodes where the absolute difference from any source-bounds latitude or longitude edge is at most 0.0005 degrees.
metric_claims.filters: Any of min/max latitude or longitude bound; this is a coordinate tolerance, not a geodesic distance.
metric_claims.scope: Exact graph SHA256 and graph content fingerprint in this registry.
metric_claims.interpretation: Boundary review signal only; no clipping defect is implied by proximity alone.

metric_claims.definition: Legacy summary field produced with a zero fallback when metadata quality-review values were unavailable.
metric_claims.filters: No SQLite crossing-tag query is established by this field value.
metric_claims.scope: Batch032 coverage report at repository revision 90a40fc.
metric_claims.interpretation: Do not present as zero crossing-tagged nodes.

metric_claims.unit: graph nodes with nonempty crossing tag
metric_claims.definition: SQLite graph_nodes rows with crossing IS NOT NULL and crossing <> empty string.
metric_claims.filters: Nonempty stored OSM crossing tag; no inference that crossing is safe or accessible.
metric_claims.scope: Exact graph SHA256 and graph content fingerprint in this registry.
metric_claims.interpretation: Tag inventory only; it is not a crossing-safety observation.

reconciliation.finding: 648 is the complete filtered source relation count/classification; 619 is the graph's stored relation count; the 29 difference is enumerated as source-only conditional/psv relations.

At revision 90a40fc the summary fields used a metadata lookup with ?? 0 and were emitted before detailed quality_evidence was attached. Revision 2d1641d later made the report producer copy detailed counts into the summary. The zero values in the immutable Batch032 report are therefore not measurements; detailed graph audit counts are 26, 944 and 1510.

evidence_boundaries: All graph quality counts are historical, source-bound audits of the exact immutable graph; no Batch041 SQLite scan or PBF rescan was performed.
Stored-record snapping is graph coverage, not geographic, sidewalk, population, boarding, or field coverage.
Graph connectivity and crossing tags do not establish pedestrian safety or a verified physical transfer.
